Container.Name: fritzfluxdb
Container.Overview:
fritzFlux is a tiny daemon that fetches connection, DSL/cable, WLAN, VPN and home-automation data from an AVM Fritz!Box router and writes it to an InfluxDB (v1 or v2) instance for visualization with tools like Grafana.
It is configured entirely through environment variables (no config file required) and has no Web UI - it runs as a background collector. A built-in watchdog restarts the collector on failure.
Important: the container must be able to reach the Fritz!Box on your LAN (default 192.168.178.1).
Pre-configured Grafana dashboards and source: https://github.com/Gill-Bates/fritzfluxdb
Container.Changes: Added Fritz!Box hostname, log level, InfluxDB v1 fields, and advanced config entries.

Config.Name: Fritz!Box Hostname/IP
Config.Description: Hostname or IP address of the Fritz!Box on your LAN

Config.Name: InfluxDB Hostname/IP
Config.Description: Hostname or IP address of the InfluxDB instance

Config.Name: InfluxDB TLS Enabled
Config.Description: Use TLS/SSL when connecting to InfluxDB (true/false)

Config.Name: InfluxDB Bucket (v2)
Config.Description: InfluxDB v2 bucket to write data to

Config.Name: InfluxDB Database (v1)
Config.Description: InfluxDB v1 database name (only for INFLUXDB_VERSION=1)

Config.Name: InfluxDB Username (v1)
Config.Description: InfluxDB v1 username, if authentication is enabled

Config.Name: InfluxDB Password (v1)
Config.Description: InfluxDB v1 password, if authentication is enabled
